Schools Campaign Encourages Students to Call Teachers on Teachers Day

Shree Niketan Schools has launched a campaign encouraging students across India to call their teachers on Teachers Day. The initiative aims to foster appreciation and connection between students and educators. The campaign's message is being disseminated through various media channels.
